# Passive Execution and Queue Control {#plan-ch13}

::: {.planned-chapter}
Planned
:::

Values a resting order as a contingent execution whose apparent spread saving must be balanced against non-fill and adverse-selection risk.

**Subtopics.** Posting versus crossing; queue priority and position; fill probability; queue depletion; cancellation and reposting; conditional markouts; adverse selection after fills; survival and hazard models; marked point processes; non-fill and deadline risk; impulse control; aggressiveness selection.
